cohort: 160 neonates born at ≥35 weeks gestation, categorized into latent iron deficiency (LID) or normal iron status (NIS) based on cord ferritin levels.
finding: No significant difference was found in ABR wave or inter-peak latencies at birth and 4-6 months of age between infants with LID and NIS, but infants with LID at birth had a significant risk of iron deficiency at 4-6 months of age.
